{{Quote|No, I don't trust their motives. That's my whole point. They can't be camped this close to us without wanting to sabotage us somehow. I know it, and I won't let it happen. I'll raise my concerns directly to Lord Ivress if I have to.|Sorven, in a message to Krigg|<ref name="Shadow of Revan" />}}
'''Krigg''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who joined the [[Order of Revan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A fellow Revanite, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sorven]], expressed concern to Krigg that the Revanites who were former members of the Republic would turn on the former Imperials.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1stm}}
